fire: Any rectangle drawn this way could have sides of any length up to ten units.
For long distances the metric system is more practical than imperial units.
The mass of a single electron is most difficult to determine directly.
In general such matrices have to be inverted numerically on a computer.
Most of these enzymes are found in the cell membrane rather than the nucleus.
A polygon of this kind could contain any number of interior angles.
In orbital mechanics the inclination is more useful than the raw coordinates.
The boundary of a fractal set is most easily described by its dimension.
quiet: Yesterday my brother could have taken the bus but he walked instead.
For long drives my old car is more comfortable than the new one.
The last slice of cake was most delicious with a cup of tea.
In the morning the dogs have to be walked before breakfast.
Most of these shirts are found in the closet rather than the drawer.
Her suitcase could contain any number of shoes and scarves.
On weekends the farmers market is more crowded than the mall.
The new cafe downtown is most easily reached by the river path.
